result.instructions: Tools for Apilo, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which orders came in today and are still unpaid?"; "Show order AL231100017 with its items and delivery address."; "Which products have a stock quantity below 5?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Apilo data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run apilo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run apilo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run apilo_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. apilo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: apilo_whoami
tools.title: Get API key info
tools.description: The Apilo API key (application) this connection uses: client id, name and the date it is valid to. GET /rest/api/whoami/.

tools.name: apilo_get_map
tools.title: Get lookup table
tools.description: Apilo's id lookup tables, each a list of { id, key, name, description }: `status` (order statuses, for apilo_list_orders and apilo_update_order_status), `payment` (payment types), `carrier`, `carrier_account`, `platform` (sales channels and their accounts), `tag`, `document` (document types), `shipment_status`. GET /rest/api/orders/<table>/map/.

tools.name: apilo_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List or search orders (all connected marketplaces and shops), with items, customer address and totals. Filter by date, status, payment, sales channel, carrier, email or phone. Status, payment, carrier and platform ids come from apilo_get_map. Page with limit/offset (reply has totalCount and next_offset). GET /rest/api/orders/.

createdAfter.description: Created at or after (ISO 8601 date or date-time; offsets are converted to UTC, no zone = UTC).

orderedAfter.description: Ordered by the buyer at or after (ISO 8601).

orderedBefore.description: Ordered by the buyer at or before (ISO 8601).

idExternal.description: The order id in the marketplace or shop.

orderStatusIds.description: Only these order statuses (ids from apilo_get_map status).

isOrderDocument.description: Only orders with (true) or without (false) an order document.

platformAccountId.description: Only orders of this sales channel account (apilo_get_map platform).

carrierId.description: Only orders with this carrier (apilo_get_map carrier).

offset.description: Records to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: apilo_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: One order in full: status, payment, items (SKU, EAN, price, quantity), customer/delivery/invoice addresses, payments, notes, discounts, carrier and sales channel. GET /rest/api/orders/{id}/.

id.description: Apilo order id, e.g. AL231100017 (the `id` of an order from apilo_list_orders).

tools.name: apilo_list_order_notes
tools.title: List order notes
tools.description: The notes of an order (internal notes and customer messages), with type 1 = customer message, 2 = internal note. GET /rest/api/orders/{id}/note/.

id.description: Apilo order id, e.g. AL231100017 (the `id` of an order from apilo_list_orders).

tools.name: apilo_list_order_documents
tools.title: List order documents
tools.description: The documents attached to an order (invoices, receipts, labels). GET /rest/api/orders/{id}/documents/.

id.description: Apilo order id, e.g. AL231100017 (the `id` of an order from apilo_list_orders).

offset.description: Records to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: apilo_list_order_shipments
tools.title: List order shipments
tools.description: The shipments created for an order (Apilo id and carrier's id). GET /rest/api/orders/{id}/shipment/.

id.description: Apilo order id, e.g. AL231100017 (the `id` of an order from apilo_list_orders).

offset.description: Records to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: apilo_get_shipment
tools.title: Get order shipment
tools.description: One shipment of an order with its details. GET /rest/api/orders/{id}/shipment/{shipment}/.

id.description: Apilo order id, e.g. AL231100017 (the `id` of an order from apilo_list_orders).

tools.name: apilo_list_shipment_tracking
tools.title: List shipment tracking
tools.description: Tracking status of shipments (status, status date and description, received date and days in transit), filtered by carrier account, post date, received date or status. Page with limit/offset (reply has totalCount and next_offset). GET /rest/api/shipping/shipment/tracking/.

postDateAfter.description: Shipment created in Apilo at or after (ISO 8601).

postDateBefore.description: Shipment created in Apilo at or before (ISO 8601).

status.description: Shipment status codes: 0 new, 1 waiting, 2 registered, 21 in delivery, 9 removed, 31 awaiting collection, 32 returning/error, 100 received, 101 return delivered.

offset.description: Records to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: apilo_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List warehouse products with SKU, EAN, name, stock quantity, prices, tax and location. Filter by id, SKU, name, EAN or status. GET /rest/api/warehouse/product/.

offset.description: Records to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: apilo_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: One warehouse product by Apilo id. GET /rest/api/warehouse/product/{id}/.

tools.name: apilo_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: Product categories with id, name and parent ids. GET /rest/api/warehouse/category/.

offset.description: Records to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: apilo_list_locations
tools.title: List warehouse locations
tools.description: Warehouse locations (shelves, bins) with id, name and code. GET /rest/api/warehouse/location/.

offset.description: Records to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: apilo_list_finance_documents
tools.title: List accounting documents
tools.description: Accounting documents (invoices, receipts, corrections) with number, amounts, currency and dates. Filter by type and invoice date. GET /rest/api/finance/documents/.

type.description: Document type: 1 invoice, 5 receipt, 10 proforma, 31 corrective invoice.

invoiceAfter.description: Invoiced at or after (ISO 8601 date or date-time).

invoiceBefore.description: Invoiced at or before (ISO 8601 date or date-time).

offset.description: Records to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: apilo_update_order_status
tools.title: Update order status
tools.description: WRITE: set an order's status (id from apilo_get_map status). Apilo may run its own automations on a status change (emails, marketplace updates, shipping). Setting the current status changes nothing. PUT /rest/api/orders/{id}/status/.

id.description: Apilo order id, e.g. AL231100017 (the `id` of an order from apilo_list_orders).

tools.name: apilo_add_order_note
tools.title: Add internal order note
tools.description: WRITE: add an INTERNAL note to an order (never a message to the customer). Not idempotent: calling twice adds two notes. POST /rest/api/orders/{id}/note/.

id.description: Apilo order id, e.g. AL231100017 (the `id` of an order from apilo_list_orders).

comment.description: The note text, up to 1024 characters.

tools.name: apilo_set_product_stock
tools.title: Set product stock quantity
tools.description: WRITE: set the stock quantity of one warehouse product to an absolute number (it replaces the current quantity, so read it with apilo_get_product first if unsure). Apilo may push the new quantity to connected marketplaces. PATCH /rest/api/warehouse/product/.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Apilo
prompts.description: What you can do with Apilo here, with example requests to try.
